product_overview: Telegram bot that generates talking head videos from user photos and text using Hedra Character 3 and Andre AIT eng voice.

general_info.name: User greeting
general_info.overview: Bot greets the user on start/launch and shows available actions.

goal_and_context.business_goal: Provide clear entry point so users understand the bot is ready.
goal_and_context.user_problem: User needs confirmation that the bot is operational.

business_rules.description: Bot must send a welcome message on /start command.

acceptance_criteria.user_story: As a user, I want the bot to greet me so I know it is ready.

bdd.then: Bot replies with a welcome message and action buttons

non_functional_requirements.description: Welcome message must be clear and concise.

test_cases.assertion: Bot replies with welcome message containing action buttons

general_info.name: Photo upload
general_info.overview: User uploads a photo to the Telegram bot for video generation.

goal_and_context.business_goal: Allow users to provide visual input for talking head generation.
goal_and_context.user_problem: User needs to supply a face photo for the video.

business_rules.description: Bot must accept photo messages from the user.
Bot must download the highest resolution version of the photo.

acceptance_criteria.user_story: As a user, I want to upload my photo so it can be used for video generation.

bdd.given: User is in the bot chat
bdd.then: Bot accepts the photo and confirms upload
and_postconditions: Photo is saved via backend API

acceptance_criteria.user_story: As a user, I want to see an error if I send non-photo content when photo is expected.

bdd.when: User sends a text message instead of a photo
bdd.then: Bot replies with an error asking for a photo

test_cases.assertion: Bot confirms photo uploaded and saved

test_cases.action: User sends text instead of photo

general_info.name: Photo storage
general_info.overview: Uploaded photos are persisted per user for reuse across sessions.

goal_and_context.user_problem: User does not want to re-upload the same photo every time.

business_rules.description: Each photo must be associated with the uploading user's Telegram ID.

acceptance_criteria.user_story: As a user, I want my photos saved so I can reuse them later.

bdd.then: Photo is stored in the database linked to the user
and_postconditions: Photo is retrievable by user ID

non_functional_requirements.description: Photos must not be lost and must remain available across sessions.

test_cases.assertion: Photo record created with correct user_id

general_info.name: Saved photo selection
general_info.overview: User selects a previously uploaded photo for the current generation.

goal_and_context.business_goal: Streamline repeat usage by allowing photo reuse.
goal_and_context.user_problem: User wants to pick from existing photos without re-uploading.

business_rules.description: Bot must display a list of saved photos for selection.
If user has no saved photos, bot must prompt to upload one.

acceptance_criteria.user_story: As a user, I want to select a saved photo for the new video.

bdd.given: User has at least one saved photo
bdd.when: User chooses to select a saved photo
bdd.then: Bot shows list of saved photos as inline buttons
and_postconditions: Selected photo is set for current generation

acceptance_criteria.user_story: As a user, I want to be prompted to upload if I have no saved photos.

bdd.when: User chooses to select a saved photo
bdd.then: Bot informs no photos found and prompts to upload

test_cases.setup: User has 2 saved photos in backend

general_info.name: Speech text input
general_info.overview: User sends the text that should be spoken in the generated video.

goal_and_context.business_goal: Capture speech content from the user.
goal_and_context.user_problem: User needs to provide the words for the talking head to say.

business_rules.description: Text length is limited to produce audio up to 18 seconds.

acceptance_criteria.user_story: As a user, I want to send speech text so the bot can generate audio.

bdd.given: Photo is selected for current generation
bdd.then: Bot accepts the text and starts generation pipeline
and_postconditions: Text is stored in FSM state

acceptance_criteria.user_story: As a user, I want an error if I send empty text.

bdd.when: User sends an empty or whitespace-only message
bdd.then: Bot replies asking for non-empty text

test_cases.action: User sends 'Hello world, this is a test'
test_cases.assertion: Bot confirms text received and starts generation

input.text: Hello world, this is a test

general_info.name: Audio generation
general_info.overview: System generates speech audio from user text using Andre AIT eng voice.

goal_and_context.business_goal: Produce audio track for the talking head video.
goal_and_context.user_problem: User needs their text converted to speech with a specific voice.

business_rules.description: Audio must be generated using voice 'Andre AIT eng'.
Audio duration must not exceed 18 seconds.

acceptance_criteria.user_story: As a user, I want my text converted to speech with Andre AIT eng voice.

bdd.then: Audio file is generated with Andre AIT eng voice

non_functional_requirements.description: Audio must use Andre AIT eng voice consistently.

general_info.name: Video generation
general_info.overview: System generates talking head video using Hedra Character 3 from photo and audio.

goal_and_context.business_goal: Produce the final talking head video.
goal_and_context.user_problem: User wants a video of a face speaking their text.

business_rules.description: Video must be generated via Hedra Character 3.
Video duration must not exceed 18 seconds.

acceptance_criteria.user_story: As a user, I want a talking head video generated from my photo and text.

bdd.then: Video is generated with correct parameters (1:1, 1080p, Hedra Character 3)

non_functional_requirements.description: Video must match parameters: Hedra Character 3, 1:1, 1080p.

test_cases.setup: Hedra service available, photo and audio ready

general_info.name: Result delivery
general_info.overview: Bot sends the generated video back to the user in Telegram.

goal_and_context.business_goal: Deliver the final product to the user.
goal_and_context.user_problem: User wants to receive and view the video directly in Telegram.

business_rules.description: Video must be sent as a video message in Telegram.

acceptance_criteria.user_story: As a user, I want to receive the generated video in Telegram.

bdd.then: Bot sends the video to the user as a Telegram video message

acceptance_criteria.user_story: As a user, I want to be notified if generation fails.

bdd.then: Bot sends an error message to the user

non_functional_requirements.description: User must not need to leave Telegram to get the result.
